newsitem.title: POLAND: Fox kills swans stuck to ice in freezing Poland.
newsitem.headline: Fox kills swans stuck to ice in freezing Poland.

text.p: A fox killed six swans which had stuck to ice as they slept during bitterly cold weather in Poland, a bird rescuer told PAP news agency on Thursday.
"Of a family of eight swans, two were saved," said Danuta Dorna, who rescues birds for provincial authorities.
Temperatures have dipped below -20C (-4F) in Poland in recent days.
